name: Evidence Clip Ledger
summary: Save the current page as a graded evidence record and export a local source ledger.
single_purpose: When the user invokes the extension, capture the active page title and URL together with a user-written fact, evidence grade, strength, case, and note in a local source ledger.
pricing: Free Store listing; monetization path must use a separately approved payment system

permissions.activeTab: Temporarily reads only the active tab title and URL when the user clicks the extension.
permissions.storage: Stores user-created evidence records in Chrome local extension storage.
